title: 2023–24 Bundesliga - Grokipedia
content: The 2023–24 Bundesliga was the top tier of professional association football in Germany, contested by 18 clubs in a round-robin format over 34 matchdays from 18 August 2023 to 18 May 2024.](#ref-1)](#ref-2) Bayer 04 Leverkusen clinched their first-ever Bundesliga title, finishing unbeaten with 28 wins, 6 draws, and 0 losses for a record 90 points and a +65 goal difference.](#ref-3)](#ref-4) Under manager Xabi Alonso, Leverkusen ended Bayern Munich's 11-year stranglehold on the league, surging to the top with a 51-game unbeaten run across all competitions that dated back to the previous season.](#ref-5)](#ref-4) VfB Stuttgart finished a surprising second with 73 points, securing their first top-two finish since 2007 and returning to the UEFA Champions League after 15 years.](#ref-3) Bayern Munich placed third with 72 points despite scoring a league-high 94 goals, while RB Leipzig took fourth on 65 points.](#ref-3) Borussia Dortmund earned a fifth Champions League spot thanks to their semi-final run in the 2023–24 UEFA Champions League.](#ref-6)](#ref-7) At the bottom, SV Darmstadt 98 and 1.
